Direct callers of `createGlobalStore` in the chart are three declarations. Two more are in the chart's own test mock, and a larger set of chart code reads the stores they create.

**Direct uses in openmrs-esm-patient-chart**

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/store/patient-chart-store.ts:19-25` creates `patient-chart-global-store`, the store behind `usePatientChartStore`. Any change to name handling, initial-state merging or the default storage type affects every chart widget that reads it.
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/store.ts:24` creates `order-basket`. `_resetOrderBasketStore` at lines 29-31 calls `setState` on it.
3. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/app/fe-wrapper/fe-wrapper.component.ts:35` creates `ampath-form-state`, which `FeWrapperComponent` subscribes to at lines 73-79.
4. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/openmrs-esm-framework.mock.ts:12-29` is the Angular test stand-in for `createGlobalStore`. It does not call the real framework, so it would not pick up a real behaviour change, but it would drift from it.

**Chart code that depends on those stores (one hop out)**

- `patient-chart-store.ts:40-42` (`setPatientChartWorkspaceGroupVisitUuid`) and `:55-71` (`usePatientChartStore`) wrap the patient-chart store.
- `orders/postOrders.ts:15` and `:163` read `orderBasketStore.getState()`.
- `orders/useOrderBasket.ts:51-56` reads and writes the order basket. I only saw this from grep hits, not the full file.
- `esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.ts:186` calls `setPatientChartWorkspaceGroupVisitUuid`, and `:82` calls `usePatientChartStore`.
- `esm-patient-common-lib/src/workspaces.ts:60`, `visit/visit-mutations.ts:23`, `esm-patient-banner-app/.../visit-tag.extension.tsx:15`, `esm-patient-vitals-app/src/utils.ts:14`, `esm-patient-chart-app/.../useDeleteVisit.tsx:18`, `.../visit-context-switcher.modal.tsx:41`, `.../end-visit-dialog.modal.tsx:23`, and `.../encounters-table.component.tsx:88` all consume `usePatientChartStore`. The grep found about 20 more consumers, and I did not read each one.

**Framework side (openmrs-esm-core)**

`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-state/src/state.ts:61-85` is the definition. It returns the existing store when a name is already registered, and it defaults `storageType` to `'none'`. A change to either would hit all the chart stores above. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-state/mock.ts:20` is the mock that chart tests get through `@openmrs/esm-framework`, so test behaviour would change with it.

**Not verified**

- Other chart repositories beyond the grep results may use the store through re-exports.
- Dynamic lookups by name (such as `getGlobalStore('order-basket')`) would not show up in a symbol search.
- I did not read the full text of the `useOrderBasket.ts`, `workspaces.ts` and other consumer files, so their line ranges come from grep hits.
